title: A shopping list with quantities
description:
Keep a shopping list in a dictionary from item to quantity.

```
> add milk 2
> add eggs 12
> add milk 1
> remove eggs
> list
milk x3
> quit
```
hints: `items[name] = items.get(name, 0) + qty` handles new and existing items in one line.
`for name in sorted(items):` visits the keys in alphabetical order.
requirements: `add <item> <qty>` adds to the quantity (starting at 0 for a new item).
`remove <item>` deletes it; an unknown item prints `No <item> on the list`.
`list` prints the items in alphabetical order as `<item> x<qty>`, or `The list is empty`.
`quit` stops the program; anything else prints `Unknown command`.
stretch: Accept `add <item>` without a quantity (meaning 1), and refuse quantities that are not whole numbers.
